author: China Insights
description:
Todd Blanche has officially become the new U.S. Attorney General after a razor-thin Senate confirmation vote.

Once known as Donald Trump's personal defense lawyer, Blanche now leads the Department of Justice and oversees the FBI, federal prosecutors, and America's top law enforcement priorities.

Why was his confirmation so controversial? What role did the debate over a proposed $1.776 billion "Anti-Weaponization Fund" play? And what could his appointment mean for the future of the Justice Department?

In this episode, we examine Todd Blanche's career, his defense of President Trump, the political battle surrounding his confirmation, and why many believe this appointment could reshape the future of American justice.

title: Trump's Personal Lawyer Confirmed as U.S. Attorney General
